part.text:
COMPLETE FINAL REVIEW

(1) BLOCKING findings: none. The supplied sources route the worker correctly: `frozen_protocol` (inference_eb.py) strips the frozen `FineMoE-EuroSys26` entry and injects `args.source` before `from finemoe.ops.prefetch import prefetch_op`, then double-checks `prefetch_op.__file__` is relative to the private source plus both revision strings, and post-model scans `sys.modules` for any `finemoe.*` outside the private tree. The preflight retains all 9 warmup+eval arrays at (16,1,151936) float32 with frozen tolerance 0.0 (`audit_cell` requires `compared_logits == 16*151936` and `max_abs_error == 0.0`; `audit_retained_logits` independently re-`np.array_equal`s all 9 after worker exit). JIT-first/native-post-check-only holds only in the shadow: `eb_jit_select` (shadow_bridge.cpp) snapshots `before`, calls the real JIT on the live `ctx`, then runs `eb_select` on a copy `reference`, never writes the JIT result away, fail-closes by pre-poisoning `active->failed`, and enforces exactly-one-JIT-call (`jit_calls == previous_calls + 1 == checks`) plus input immutability; full mode uses `libeb_policy.so` directly (jit_bridge.cpp has no native check) and `audit_engagement` proves `real_selector_library is None`, `shadow is None`, `jit_calls == decisions > 0`. ABI/count/lifetime: static_asserts on entry/context sizes, overflow guard at `numeric_limits<eb_u64>::max`, one-active handle with self-recursion rejection (`next->open == &eb_jit_open`), counters as file-scope globals that survive `eb_jit_close` while the Python `CDLL` keeps the shadow mapped (`shadow_snapshot` runs before `clean_up_resources`, which destroys the jit handle but not the shadow library). Callback reuse of `run_stage` is shape-compatible: `command(args, stage, directory, arm)`, `audit_cell(record, data, arm, mode=="preflight", golden)`, zero-arg `inventory`, `child_environment(**kwargs)`, and both cleanup aliases map onto `stop_owned`, whose owned-PGID survivor check is correct for the `start_new_session` children. Token/timing boundaries, whole-expert copy records (8-field, within the steady_clock window, started==completed==admissions), zero speculative counters, hit/miss==decisions arithmetic, strict-pool/residency conservation, per-block `matching_decisions`, non-overlapping cross-process monotonic windows, and the block-major `paired` bootstrap (5 aligned cells per arm) are all internally consistent with `audit_cell`'s published metrics. No hashes used; no frozen file edited.

(2) Bounded non-blocking caveats: (a) `expected_decoding` (correctness.py) indexes raw JSON keys of `generation_config.json` while the worker's stored dict comes from `GenerationConfig.from_pretrained` + `decoding_configuration`; if any of the 7 fields is absent (GenerationConfig defaults it) the audit raises `KeyError`, and if transformers coerces any value the exact dict equality fails — unresolvable from supplied sources and exercised only by the still-unrun real preflight. (b) `audit_engagement` hard-requires `0 < delta["evictions"]`, so a capacity-60 zero-eviction run would be rejected; harmless at the fixed K=16 candidate. (c) `stop_exact_process` is aliased to `stop_owned`, so telemetry cleanup now kills the telemetry's own process group rather than the single pid — safe because it is a session leader, but broader than the original semantics. (d) the in-process monkeypatches of `common.*` are not restored after main; acceptable for a single-purpose driver.

(3) Growth justified: the new gated 5-block/15-cell mode, the separate CPU-only shadow bridge, and the analyzer's reuse of the existing `paired` bootstrap add capability without duplicating the FineMoE campaign framework. Removable boilerplate is small: `test_sources_parse_without_importing_gpu_worker` partially duplicates coverage already forced by `import correctness`, and `audit_saved_cell` reconstructs a `SimpleNamespace` just to re-derive the command string that `result.json` already stores verbatim.

(4) Authorized: every behavioral change (process-local callback swap of `command/audit_cell/inventory/child_environment/stop_owned`, new shadow `libeb_shadow.so` never rebuilding the selector, demand-only current-batch EB with `data_size == 0` and `--history`/`--check-logits` gates, and the new analyzer importing the existing paired statistics) stays inside the declared scope; State, adapter_live.inc, the private offloader, original FineMoE sources and old raw outputs are untouched by these seven files.
